title: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold launches with a new Viking class, a collaboration with Final Fantasy VII, and a release date on Switch 2
summary: Square Enix details the expansion's content, which includes a raid against Sephiroth and will be available on Nintendo Switch 2 starting August 4, 2026.

title: Thick As Thieves ends support but the studio keeps it playable
summary: The stealth game directed by Warren Spector has stopped receiving updates after two months, but the developers assure it will continue to work.

title: Silent Hill f writers had to read between 100 and 200 books per year to prepare the script
summary: The game's producer imposed a demanding reading pace on the writers to ensure the narrative depth of the title.

title: A third-person camera mod transforms the Baldur's Gate 3 experience
summary: A modification allows absolute camera control in the style of action role-playing games, improving immersion.

title: A mod unites GTA 3, Vice City, and San Andreas into a single connected universe
summary: The creation allows instant travel among the three Rockstar classics, offering an unprecedented open experience.

title: Apple TV shows the Neuromancer trailer and sets its release date
summary: The adaptation of William Gibson's novel will arrive on the streaming platform soon, with a preview very faithful to the original material.

title: Christopher Nolan adapts The Odyssey to film and generates divided opinions
summary: While some viewers are impressed by the film, expert Emily Wilson criticizes that the director omits central themes of the poem.

title: Marvel Studios confirms new Black Panther and Ryan Gosling as Ghost Rider at Comic Con
summary: The Hall H panel at San Diego Comic Con brought the studio's most anticipated announcements, including the cast of Black Panther 3 and the upcoming Ghost Rider.
